This is not an EVAL closeness metric and not a binding result. Quantiles use the implemented nearest-rank index int(round(p * (n - 1))) on values sorted ascending. No confidence interval is defined. Directions on nearest_train_normalized_edit_distance and maximum_edit_similarity_to_train describe novelty only and are not extra votes for overall generator quality.

metrics.seed_or_block_treatment: The implemented functions summarise the supplied attempt ledger. They do not treat candidate rows, generation chunks, B1 length-control seeds, length-sampling seeds, or the single B2 empirical-null seed as independent training replicates. D1 training seeds are the training-replicate unit when more than one exists; these functions do not aggregate across that unit.
metrics.condition_scope: Report B0, B1, B2, and D1 separately. Do not pool B0's historical 37-nt regime into a matched-length B1/D1 contrast.

metrics.data_source: caller-supplied fold of each distinct valid sequence, repeated on valid rows
metrics.calculation_summary: Quantiles of float(mfe) divided by the sequence length. The code key is mfe_per_nt. The configuration token mfe_per_nucleotide is not a second metric. More negative MFE per nucleotide is not a selection score. Quantiles use the implemented nearest-rank index int(round(p * (n - 1))) on values sorted ascending. No confidence interval is defined.
metrics.denominator_and_filters: Sequence length in nucleotides. Quantiles are over valid rows. Division by zero is not reached because valid sequences are nonempty.
metrics.expected_range: null when there are no valid rows; otherwise quantiles of unconstrained floats
metrics.length_treatment: Divides MFE by the valid sequence length. It does not define a short/long regime.
metrics.missing_failure_handling: No valid rows yields a null quantile summary. GEP-1 does not call a fold.
metrics.seed_or_block_treatment: The implemented functions summarise the supplied attempt ledger. They do not treat candidate rows, generation chunks, B1 length-control seeds, length-sampling seeds, or the single B2 empirical-null seed as independent training replicates. D1 training seeds are the training-replicate unit when more than one exists; these functions do not aggregate across that unit.
metrics.condition_scope: Report B0, B1, B2, and D1 separately. Do not pool B0's historical 37-nt regime into a matched-length B1/D1 contrast.

metrics.data_source: dot-bracket string returned by the caller-supplied fold
metrics.calculation_summary: Quantiles of (count of '(' plus count of ')') divided by the sequence length. Unpaired positions are not added to the numerator. Quantiles use the implemented nearest-rank index int(round(p * (n - 1))) on values sorted ascending. No confidence interval is defined.
metrics.numerator: paired parentheses in the fold structure
metrics.denominator_and_filters: Sequence length. The structure length must equal the sequence length. Quantiles are over valid rows.
metrics.expected_range: null when there are no valid rows; otherwise quantiles of values in [0, 1] for a consistent dot-bracket
metrics.length_treatment: Normalized by sequence length. No short/long cutoff is defined.
metrics.missing_failure_handling: No valid rows yields a null quantile summary. A structure of the wrong length raises fold_invalid. GEP-1 does not call a fold.
metrics.seed_or_block_treatment: The implemented functions summarise the supplied attempt ledger. They do not treat candidate rows, generation chunks, B1 length-control seeds, length-sampling seeds, or the single B2 empirical-null seed as independent training replicates. D1 training seeds are the training-replicate unit when more than one exists; these functions do not aggregate across that unit.
metrics.condition_scope: Report B0, B1, B2, and D1 separately. Do not pool B0's historical 37-nt regime into a matched-length B1/D1 contrast.

metrics.data_source: generation attempt ledger grouped by requested_target_length
metrics.reference_role: none for the grouping; stratum blocks use the same TRAIN and fold references as the unstratified diagnostics
metrics.calculation_summary: The by_requested_length list. Each requested length repeats the report-only block for its valid rows and adds raw_attempts, exact_length_hits, and exact_hit_rate for every attempt at that length. This is a stratification, not an aggregate generator-quality score, and it does not define a new length boundary.
metrics.numerator: the unstratified report-only numerators, restricted to one requested length
metrics.denominator_and_filters: The unstratified denominators, restricted to that requested length. Attempts at other lengths are reported in their own strata.
metrics.units: the units of the stratified metrics
metrics.expected_range: one stratum per requested length present in the ledger
metrics.length_treatment: Grouped by requested_target_length only. B0 is not pooled into a matched-length B1/D1 contrast by this grouping.
metrics.missing_failure_handling: An empty ledger yields an empty stratum list. A stratum with no valid rows carries null structure and distance summaries and a defined attempt count.

They do not treat candidate rows, generation chunks, B1 length-control seeds, length-sampling seeds, or the single B2 empirical-null seed as independent training replicates. D1 training seeds are the training-replicate unit when more than one exists; these functions do not aggregate across that unit.

blocking_items.statement: On a schema-valid ledger, parsed_outputs equals raw_attempts, including empty unparseable rows. Thesis wording that treats parsed as successfully parsed is not the same predicate. GEP-1 also reports the synthetic contract field parsed_status and does not rename parsed_outputs.
m6 REPORT_ONLY_ITEMS names requested_length_exact_hit_rate. The implemented metric id is exact_hit_rate. The public freeze of the alias is unresolved, so it is not a second metric.

generator_evaluation.yaml names maximum_identity_to_TRAIN. The implemented key is maximum_edit_similarity_to_train, and the code states that this is an edit-based similarity, not a sequence identity. Those tokens are not frozen as synonyms.

The configuration and report-only token is mfe_per_nucleotide. The implemented result key is mfe_per_nt. The public token is not frozen, so GEP-1 keeps the code key and does not create a second metric.

validation_metrics_v1.yaml records historical provisional references for requested-length and per-length exact-hit rates. m4_diagnostic_metrics.py does not implement those references as pass/fail decisions, and exact_hit_rate_is_an_eligibility_threshold is false.
No separate GC-fraction metric is implemented. Nucleotide fractions are the implemented composition descriptor.
Clustering-dependent diversity metrics are deferred beyond M4. No identity threshold is implemented. GEP-1 does not invent one.
Frozen representation or embedding metrics are not implemented. GEP-1 does not add one.

No EVAL distance or closeness metric is implemented. Generated-distribution similarity, were it later measured, would not demonstrate binding, affinity, selectivity, inhibition, or NDM-1-specific learning.

composition and total_variation can emit nucleotide_total_variation_to_train. Whether that comparison is a separate frozen thesis metric, rather than part of nucleotide_distribution, is unresolved. It is not EVAL closeness.
The same function can emit dinucleotide_total_variation_to_train. Separate thesis membership is unresolved. It is not EVAL closeness.

No generator-evaluation confidence interval, hypothesis test, or bootstrap is specified by the implemented metric functions. GEP-1 does not invent one. With fewer than two D1 training seeds, uncertainty excludes training-run variability.
TRAIN-reference metrics are specified from the implemented functions. GEP-1 does not load TRAIN and does not compute them.
MFE and paired fraction are implemented behind a caller-supplied fold. GEP-1 does not call ViennaRNA or any other fold.

The implemented matched B1/D1 provenance is the shared schedule compared by m6_diagnostic_generation.assert_pairing: invocation_index, batch_position, requested_target_length, max_seq_len, and invocation_seed, together with the shared length-schedule provenance from build_schedule (target_length_sampling_seed, length-vector identity, generation_seed_base, seed formula, and max_seq_len formula). GEP-1 checks those fields on synthetic rows. A shared generation_chunk_id is not sufficient. The production schedule and pool artefacts are not loaded.

The B2 raw record uses a generic seed field. GEP-1 rejects that ambiguous field. The single B2 sampler seed is empirical_null_seed and is not a training replicate. A production mapping from the B2 manifest field is not wired.

novelty_direction_statement: Directions on nearest_train_normalized_edit_distance and maximum_edit_similarity_to_train describe novelty only and are not extra votes for overall generator quality.
